played.text: I need to step outside to collect the harbor ledger. I will be back soon.
All right. I know you said you will return, but my stomach has gone cold. Please do not vanish.
I am back, as promised. Here is the harbor ledger.
You came back. I let out the breath I was holding, and my grip on your sleeve loosens. Thank you.
